Leaps through the air and performs a melee with extended lunge distance upon releasing [Melee Attack]. Shatters <stasis Stasis Crystals /> on contact.

Failing to score a hit refunds <pve 80% /> <pvp [40%] /> Melee Ability Energy.

Hits deal <pve 511 /> <pvp [105] /> impact damage and apply <pve 50 /> <pvp [40] /> stacks of <stasis Slow />. Knockback is heavy in PvE and moderate in PvP.

Hits also attach a delayed explosive that detonates after 1 second, dealing up to <pve 219 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and applying <pve 100 /> <pvp [40] /> stacks of <stasis Slow />, scaling down to 20% damage at the edge of the 8 meter radius.

Both the impact and the explosion benefit from Melee Damage increases. Impact damage is non-lethal.

Guardians directly hit have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds.

source.text:
Leaps through the air, performing an extended lunge distance melee upon releasing [Melee Attack].
Shiver Strike shatters Stasis Crystals on contact. 
Failing to score a hit will refund 80% [40%] Melee Ability Energy.

Deals 511 [105] impact damage on hit, heavily [moderately] knocking enemies back and inflicting x50 [x40] Slow.
Hits attach a delayed Stasis Explosive that deals up to 219 [?] explosive damage and inflicting x100 [x40] Slow after 1 second to enemies, down to 20% damage over 8 meters.
Both the Impact and Explosion benefit from Melee Damage Increases. Impact damage is non-lethal.
Guardians directly hit by Shiver Strike have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds.
Base Cooldown: 146.3 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.7x
